Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds associated with the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4004822. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to include canonical SMILES, allowing nulls if structures are missing. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID.
